records.explanation: Azure Interior's invoices less credit notes in intermediate.int_invoices total 73,025 USD across 3 documents, and all of its billing is in USD.
records.sql: SELECT currency, SUM(CASE WHEN move_type = 'out_refund' THEN -amount ELSE amount END) AS net_billed, COUNT(*) AS documents FROM intermediate.int_invoices WHERE customer_name ILIKE '%azure interior%' AND move_type IN ('out_invoice', 'out_refund') GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency;
